page.overview:
Who is Baseball Announcer 1?

Baseball Announcer 1 is a sports announcer at the Springfield War Memorial Stadium. Along with Baseball Announcer 2, he reports during the instance when Marge Simpson's Pretzel Wagon brings pretzels to the stadium. He remarks as the audience throws the pretzels at Charles Montgomery Burns for his proposed prize of the 1997 Pontiac Astro Wagon, and eventually also throw them at baseball player Whitey Ford.

The character design and voice are based on , announcer for the L.A. Dodgers.
